raw.details:
Welcome to RISE CodeStorm 2026, the flagship 28-hour software development hackathon hosted by the Department of RISE (Research, Innovations, Sponsored Projects & Entrepreneurship) at Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC), Landran in association with ACIC RISE Association, supported by AIM, NITI Aayog, Govt. of India.

This is not an idea pitch. This is a BUILD from scratch hackathon. You arrive, you get your theme, you build your working software product on campus with expert mentors guiding you, you stay overnight, and you present it live to judges.

Dates & Venue:

  • Date: 28th September (10:00 AM) to 29th September (2:00 PM), 2026
  • Duration: 28 Hours Continuous
  • Venue: RISE Department, Innovation Hub, CGC Landran, Mohali, Punjab - 140307
  • Mode: Offline / In-Person Only

About The Hackathon:

Over 2 days, 200+ innovators from across India will code, build, and launch solutions for real-world problems. Day 1 is the Build Day where you will receive instructions, choose your theme, and start developing your product under the guidance of our expert team. Overnight accommodation on 28th night will be provided on campus. Day 2 is Pitch Day where you present your platform in front of our judges.

Who Can Participate?

Eligibility:

  • Open to students of any University / College in India - B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc IT, MBA Tech, Diploma, any stream.
  • Both school students with coding background and college students can participate.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • No registration fee.

Team Formation Rules:

  • Team size: Exactly 2 members. Solo participation is NOT allowed.
  • One person cannot be part of multiple teams.
  • Team leader must register on Unstop and add the teammate.
  • Both members must be present on campus with valid College ID + Unstop registration proof.

Themes - Choose Any One Out Of 6:

You have to build a working software product based on any one theme:

Theme 1: AI & Generative Intelligence

Build with LLMs, Computer Vision, NLP, Automation. Examples: AI placement interviewer, AI notes summarizer for students, GenAI code reviewer, AI attendance proxy detector.

Theme 2: HealthTech & Wellness Innovation

Telemedicine, mental health, fitness, medical records. Examples: Hostel medicine reminder app, mental wellness chatbot for students, blood donor finder for Mohali region.

Theme 3: Smart Education & Future Of Learning (EdTech)

LMS, skill development, AR/VR labs, gamification. Examples: Virtual RISE lab simulator, peer-to-peer doubt solving platform for CGC, gamified DSA learning platform.

Theme 4: FinTech, Blockchain & Digital Trust

UPI, payments, fraud detection, smart contracts. Examples: Campus expense splitter with blockchain proof, fake certificate verification system, UPI fraud alert system.

Theme 5: Sustainable Tech, Smart Cities, IoT & AgriTech

Sustainability, IoT, smart campus, agriculture. Examples: CGC hostel energy consumption dashboard, smart parking system for campus, crop disease detection for Punjab farmers.

Theme 6: Open Innovation - Cybersecurity & Social Good

Cyber safety, women safety, accessibility, social impact. Examples: Phishing link detector for students, SOS safety app with live location, NGO volunteer matching platform.

Format, Process & Stages:

Stage 1: Registration On Unstop

Register your team of 2 on Unstop. Registrations close on 27th Sept 2026, 11:59 PM.

Stage 2: Offline Hackathon At CGC Landran (Final Round)

Day 1 - 28th Sept - Build Day:

  • 10:00 AM - Reporting, Registration & Verification at RISE Dept
  • 10:30 AM - Inauguration Ceremony & Rules Briefing by Dean RISE
  • 11:00 AM - Theme Finalization & Hacking Begins!
  • 01:30 PM - Lunch Break
  • 02:30 PM - Mentoring Round 1: Tech Stack & Architecture Check
  • 05:00 PM - Tea Break + Mentoring Round 2: UI/UX & Feasibility Review
  • 08:00 PM - Dinner
  • 09:00 PM onwards - Overnight Building Continues (Labs Open All Night)

Day 2 - 29th Sept - Pitch Day:

  • 08:00 AM - Breakfast
  • 09:00 AM - Final Build & Documentation
  • 11:00 AM - Final Submission Deadline (GitHub Repo + 5-Slide PPT + 2-min Demo Video)
  • 11:30 AM - Final Presentations Start (5 mins Pitch + 3 mins Q&A per team)
  • 01:30 PM - Judging & Evaluation
  • 02:00 PM - Results Announcement, Prize Distribution & Valedictory

Prizes & Rewards:

  • Winner: INR 20,000 + Trophy + Winner Certificate + Incubation Support at ACIC RISE
  • 1st Runner-up: INR 10,000 + Trophy + Certificate + Mentorship
  • 2nd Runner-up: INR 5,000 + Trophy + Certificate
  • Total Prize Pool: INR 35,000

All Participants Get:

  • Participation Certificate from CGC Landran & Dept of RISE
  • Free Meals: Lunch & Dinner on 28th, Breakfast on 29th
  • Free Overnight Accommodation on 28th Sept (Separate Hostels for Boys/Girls)
  • Mentorship from Industry Experts & RISE Faculty
  • Swag Kit, High-speed WiFi, Lab Access
  • Networking with Startups Incubated at ACIC RISE

Judging Criteria:

  • Innovation & Uniqueness: 30%
  • Technical Implementation & Code Quality: 25%
  • Real-World Impact & Feasibility: 20%
  • UI/UX & Design: 15%
  • Presentation & Demo: 10%

Rules & Guidelines:

  • You must build your product during the hackathon hours only. Pre-built projects are not allowed. Use of open-source libraries, APIs, and frameworks is allowed.
  • Plagiarism or copying code without attribution will lead to direct disqualification.
  • You must bring your own laptop, charger, and extension cords. Internet will be provided.
  • Accommodation for 28th night will be provided inside campus. Please carry your personal overnight kit, bedsheets will be provided.
  • Food arrangements are for registered participants only.
  • Participants must maintain discipline and follow CGC campus rules.
  • Decision of Judges and RISE Department will be final and binding.
  • Teams must be present for the entire duration. Leaving campus during hacking hours without permission is not allowed.

What To Bring:

  • Laptop
  • Charger
  • College ID Card
  • Unstop Registration Proof
  • Water Bottle
  • Personal Overnight Kit

Contact Us:

Department of RISE, CGC Landran

Venue: RISE Innovation Hub, CGC College of Engineering, Landran, Sector 112, Mohali, Punjab

FAQs:

  • Is it free? Yes, completely free. No registration fee.
  • Can I participate alone? No, team must be exactly 2.
  • Is it open for other colleges? Yes, open for students of any university across India.
  • Will accommodation be given? Yes, for the night of 28th Sept on campus.
  • Do I need to bring an idea? You will choose a theme on Day 1 and build from scratch with mentor help.

Build. Innovate. RISE. See you at CGC Landran on 28th Sept!
